asimetris.detail: Carries the makeshift scrap-built energy rifle
Leather pouch worn on the hip
Large grey patch sewn over the shoulder
Smaller indigo patch on the elbow
Glowing cyan energy cell is socketed into the right side of the rifle's main body
A bundle of exposed wires runs along the left side of the rifle's frame
A long, frayed tear along the bottom hem of the coat

tetap: The character's hood is up to obscure their face, their right hand holds the energy rifle, and their left hand rests on the leather pouch at their hip.
